h:
一个工作流程，提供 2 张人脸图像并预测未来婴儿的脸部。

它基于人脸组合操作进行工作，并且可以在 ZENid 组合人脸节点中设置从人脸中获取图像的比例。

在提示部分，您需要定义“一个女孩，2 岁，漂亮 - 一个男孩，1 岁，英俊”。

检查站：JuggernatXL -https://civitai.com/models/133005?modelVersionId=782002

ControlNet 模型：Diffuion_pytorch_model -

https://huggingface.co/InstantX/InstantID/blob/main/ControlNetModel/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors

o.en:
A workflow that gives 2 human face images and predicts the face of their future babies.

It works based on the face combine operation and the proportion of which image is taken from the face can be set in the ZENid Combine face node.

In the Prompt section you need to define “a girl, 2 years old, beautiful - a boy, 1 years old, handsome”.

CheckPoint : JuggernatXL -https://civitai.com/models/133005?modelVersionId=782002

ControlNet Model : Diffuion_pytorch_model -

https://huggingface.co/InstantX/InstantID/blob/main/ControlNetModel/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors
